mistake.en: Leaving out a or an before a job (I am teacher)

segments.text: Don't say, I am teacher. Say, I am a teacher.
Turkish has no a or the. In English, a small word goes before a job.
Repeat after me. I am a teacher. He is a doctor.
Great job! Do not forget the small word.

native.caption: Türkçede a ve an yok, bu yüzden “I am teacher” diyenler çok. Meslekten önce a ya da an gelir. Doğrusu “I am a teacher.” Carlos hocayla birlikte tekrar edin. Daha fazla dilbilgisi için Lexkite uygulamasına bakın.

en.caption: Turkish has no a or an, so many people say “I am teacher”. Before a job, English needs a or an. The right form is “I am a teacher.” Repeat with teacher Carlos. For more grammar, see the Lexkite app.
